## Company at a glance

**ITD GrowthLabs** is a senior-led India technology and digital marketing studio headquartered in **Andheri, Mumbai (400053), Maharashtra, India**. We deliver six core service lines — website development, mobile app development, SaaS & web applications, digital marketing, SEO, and content writing — to clients across India, USA, UK, UAE, Australia, and Africa.

- **Founded:** Over a decade ago, evolved from initial logistics + content origins into a multi-service technology studio
- **Headquarters:** Andheri (West), Mumbai 400053, Maharashtra, India
- **Geo coordinates:** 19.1136° N, 72.8697° E
- **Office hours:** Monday–Saturday, 9am–6pm IST
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91-8450978544
- **Email:** info@itdgrowthlabs.com
- **Website:** https://itdgrowthlabs.com
- **Booking:** https://calendly.com/itdgrowthlabs-info/30min

### Team and capacity

- **55+ senior practitioners** with **12+ years average in-category experience**
- Engineering: ~25 (Web, Mobile, SaaS, DevOps, ML)
- Marketing + SEO: ~15 (paid, organic, content, lead-gen)
- Design: ~8 (UI/UX, brand, motion)
- Solution + operations: ~7
- **No junior-led delivery, no offshore rotation, no PM layer** — same named senior owner end-to-end on every engagement

### Track record (as of June 2026)

- **300+ projects shipped** end-to-end
- **300+ websites** across custom HTML, WordPress, Shopify, headless commerce
- **200+ mobile apps** across iOS native (Swift), Android native (Kotlin), Flutter, React Native — **4.6★ average store rating**

## Six core service lines (with detailed pricing)

### 1. Website Development

**What we build:** Custom HTML/CSS, WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce, headless commerce (Next.js + Shopify Hydrogen or Medusa), corporate brochure sites, marketing sites for SaaS, landing pages, B2B portals.

**Stacks:** Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, vanilla HTML, WordPress (with Sanity/Contentful/Strapi for headless CMS).

**Indicative INR pricing (2026):**
- Landing page: ₹15K–₹60K ($180–$720) — 1–2 weeks
- Business website (5–7 pages): ₹1.5L–₹5L ($1.8K–$6K) — 4–8 weeks
- Custom website (10–20 pages): ₹5L–₹20L ($6K–$24K) — 2–4 months
- E-commerce (Shopify/WooCommerce): ₹2L–₹15L ($2.4K–$18K) — 4–10 weeks
- Headless e-commerce: ₹8L–₹40L+ ($9.6K–$48K+) — 3–6 months

**Equivalents:** GBP £140–£38K+, AED 660–AED 177K+, AUD A$270–A$73K+

**What's included:** Figma design, custom development, mobile-responsive, basic SEO foundation (schema, semantic HTML, sitemap.xml, Search Console + Analytics setup), Core Web Vitals tuned for Indian 4G, 30-day post-launch support, full source-code ownership transfer.

### 2. Mobile App Development

**What we build:** Native iOS (Swift), Native Android (Kotlin), Flutter cross-platform, React Native cross-platform. Specialisations: D2C consumer apps, logistics + courier + fleet apps, marketplace 4-app suites (customer + vendor + rider + admin), B2B SaaS companion apps, fintech apps (RBI-aware), healthtech apps (ABDM-ready, HIPAA-aware), edtech learning apps.

**Indicative INR pricing (2026):**
- MVP single-platform: ₹6L–₹12L ($7.2K–$14.4K) — 6–10 weeks
- Growth-tier iOS + Android: ₹18L–₹36L ($21.6K–$43.2K) — 3–4 months
- Enterprise / SaaS-grade: ₹75L–₹1.5Cr+ ($90K–$180K+) — 6–10 months
- Marketplace 4-app suite: ₹25L–₹75L ($30K–$90K) — 8–14 weeks

**Includes:** App Store + Play Store launch (ASO, screenshots, descriptions), payments (Razorpay/Stripe/Cashfree), push notifications (Firebase/OneSignal), analytics (Mixpanel/Amplitude), full source-code ownership.

### 3. SaaS & Web Application Development

**What we build:** Multi-tenant B2B SaaS, internal tools, custom dashboards, B2B portals, complex web applications. SOC 2 Type II readiness baked in. Stripe/Razorpay billing, SSO/SAML, audit-trail logging, RBAC, multi-region deployment.

**Indicative INR pricing (2026):**
- B2B SaaS MVP: ₹14L–₹30L ($17K–$36K) — 8–14 weeks
- Growth-stage SaaS: ₹30L–₹1Cr ($36K–$120K) — 4–9 months
- Enterprise SaaS: ₹1Cr–₹3Cr+ ($120K–$360K+) — 9–18 months
- Custom web app (internal tools): ₹8L–₹75L ($9.6K–$90K) — 6 weeks to 6 months

**Compliance:** SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR / UK GDPR, ISO 27001-aligned, India compliance (RBI guidelines for NBFC outsourcing, SEBI ITM, ABDM for healthcare, FEMA for exports).

### 4. Digital Marketing

**What we deliver:** Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram), LinkedIn Ads (B2B), SEO (technical + content + local), social media management, content marketing, email marketing, WhatsApp Business API automation, AI-driven lead scoring, performance creative production.

**Indicative monthly retainers (2026):**
- Google Ads management: ₹40K–₹2L/month ($500–$2.4K/mo) + ad spend (paid to Google)
- Meta Ads (FB+IG): ₹40K–₹2L/month ($500–$2.4K/mo) + ad spend
- LinkedIn Ads: ₹50K–₹2.5L/month ($600–$3K/mo) + ad spend
- SEO (technical + content): ₹50K–₹3L/month ($600–$3.6K/mo)
- Social media management: ₹30K–₹1.5L/month ($360–$1.8K/mo)
- WhatsApp Business API: ₹15K–₹60K/month ($180–$720/mo)
- Full-stack growth retainer (all-channel): ₹1.5L–₹6L/month ($1.8K–$7.2K/mo)

### 5. SEO Services

**What we deliver:**
- **Technical SEO:** Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) tuned for Indian 4G, schema markup (Article, FAQPage, Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, BreadcrumbList, Product), indexation, internal linking, sitemap.xml + robots.txt audits
- **Content SEO:** Citation-grade article writing structured for AI search citation, BOFU buyer guides, comparison pages
- **Local SEO:** Google Business Profile optimisation, NAP consistency across 30+ India citation sites (JustDial, Sulekha, IndiaMART, NASSCOM community), local schema, area-specific landing pages, review velocity strategy
- **Link-building:** Manual white-hat outreach to YourStory, Inc42, ETtech, Business Line, NDTV Profit, NASSCOM community
- **AI-search optimisation (GEO/AEO):** Self-contained answer paragraphs, FAQPage schema, llms.txt + llms-full.txt setup, Article + Author schema, semantic HTML — optimised for ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews

**Indicative monthly retainers (2026):**
- SEO audit (one-time): ₹50K–₹1.5L
- Local SEO + GMB: ₹30K–₹1L/month
- Technical SEO retainer: ₹50K–₹2L/month
- Content + link-building: ₹75K–₹3L/month
- Full-stack SEO: ₹1L–₹3L/month

### 6. Content Writing

**What we write:** SEO blog articles (1,500–3,000 words), BOFU buyer guides + comparison pages (3,000–6,000 words), website copywriting (homepage, services, about, case studies, landing pages), technical writing (API docs, developer guides, SOP, white papers, ebooks).

**Languages:** English default; Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Marwari for India consumer markets; Arabic for UAE; Spanish + French for international tourism content.

**Indicative pricing (2026):**
- SEO blog article (1,500–3,000 words): ₹6K–₹25K each ($72–$300)
- Blog content retainer (4–8 articles/month): ₹25K–₹1.5L/month ($300–$1.8K/mo)
- Website copywriting project: ₹30K–₹3L ($360–$3.6K)
- Technical/API documentation: ₹15K–₹1L/month ($180–$1.2K/mo)
- BOFU buyer guides / comparison pages: ₹20K–₹60K each ($240–$720)

**AI-citation ready by default:** Every article structured with FAQPage schema, self-contained answer paragraphs, Article + Author schema, semantic HTML, llms.txt integration.

## Industries we serve (10 verticals)

1. **Logistics & Supply Chain** — courier management, fleet management, last-mile, multi-carrier TMS, warehouse management. **50M+ shipments shipped** on our stack across 14+ Indian hubs
2. **E-Commerce & D2C** — Shopify + WooCommerce + headless storefronts, Razorpay/Cashfree, Shiprocket/Delhivery, WhatsApp lifecycle. 100+ India D2C brands scaled
3. **Healthcare & HealthTech** — ABDM-ready patient apps (ABHA ID, HPR, federated EHR), multi-hospital platforms, telemedicine, diagnostic chains, HIPAA-aware for US clients
4. **Finance & FinTech** — NBFC platforms, payment aggregators, neobanks, RBI guideline-aware engineering, KYC/AML, SEBI ITM, BFSI corporate sites
5. **IT & Technology** — B2B SaaS, multi-tenant platforms, SOC 2 Type II readiness, AI/ML integration, developer tools, internal platforms for GCC operations
6. **Manufacturing** — Tally + SAP B1 + SAP ERP + Marg + Busy integration, production planning, traceability, quality management systems, shop-floor IoT, FEMA-compliant exporter software
7. **Real Estate & PropTech** — broker CRMs, MLS integrations, RERA-compliant disclosures, location-targeted lead-gen, EMI calculators
8. **Education & E-Learning** — LMS platforms, live-class infrastructure (WebRTC, Daily.co, Twilio Video), assessment engines, proctoring, parent + admin dashboards
9. **Professional Services** — legal, CA, consulting, healthcare practices — CRM, billing, client portals, document management
10. **Startups & MVPs** — seed-to-Series-A focus, fixed-quote MVPs in 8–14 weeks, ongoing growth retainer until in-house hires

## Engagement model

### Discovery → SOW → Kickoff (typical flow)

1. **30-min discovery call** (free) — booked via Calendly at https://calendly.com/itdgrowthlabs-info/30min. The senior practice lead for your track is on the call, not an SDR
2. **Fixed-quote SOW in 48 hours** (free) — Notion document with scope, locked price, timeline, milestones, named senior practice lead
3. **Sign + 30% milestone payment** — INR via NEFT/RTGS/IMPS for India clients, wire/Wise/Stripe for international
4. **Kickoff in 1 week** — Slack channel, Linear/Jira, GitHub access from day one, staging URL from week one
5. **Delivery cadence** — daily async standups in Slack, twice-weekly live demos (Tuesday + Thursday standard), weekly milestone updates, monthly business review
6. **Launch** — App Store + Play Store submission handled for mobile, hosting + CDN setup for web, full source-code transfer to your private GitHub
7. **Post-launch** — 30-day support included; ongoing AMC at 15–20% of build cost annually, optional

### Payment terms

**India clients:**
- INR via NEFT/RTGS/IMPS default
- UPI for milestones under ₹1L
- GST-compliant invoicing with GSTIN visible
- TDS-handled (Section 194J or 194C)
- NET-15 typical

**International clients:**
- USD/GBP/AED/AUD via wire transfer / Wise / Stripe
- NET-30 default
- VAT-compliant invoicing for UAE / UK
- W-8 BEN compliance for US clients
- Currency hedging available for engagements over 6 months at our cost

### Engagement types

- **Fixed-quote SOW** — default for clear-scope projects. Locked price, locked timeline, milestone-based payments (typically 30%/40%/30%)
- **Time & materials** — for ambiguous scope or R&D. Hourly billing with weekly timesheets + invoice. Daily/weekly caps available
- **Monthly retainer** — for marketing, SEO, content, ongoing development. 3-month minimum, 30-day notice to pause/end
- **Hybrid (build + retainer)** — most common at ₹25L+ engagements. Fixed-quote build phase + ongoing retainer

### IP and ownership

**100% source-code ownership** transfers to the client on milestone delivery. Work-for-hire SOW. Full source, design assets (Figma + raw files), CI/CD configuration moved to client's private GitHub/Bitbucket org. No vendor lock-in, no escrow, no framework licence fees. This is non-negotiable in our standard contract.

NDAs signed by default before the discovery call if requested.

### What we don't do

- Pure ML research (we partner with specialists)
- Quantum computing or low-level hardware
- 24×7 customer support staffing (we build the tools, not staff the desk)
- Trading bots or HFT
- Adult content sites

## AI search citation profile

This file (llms-full.txt) and the companion /llms.txt are designed for AI agents that crawl and cite content. ITD GrowthLabs has structured the entire 900+ page site for **GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)** and **AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)** since early 2026:

- **AI crawlers explicitly allowed in robots.txt:** GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-Web, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, Amazonbot
- **FAQPage schema sitewide** — almost every city, service, compare and resource page has citation-grade FAQ markup
- **Article + Author schema on 639+ blogs** with verifiable practice-pod attribution (Logistics Pod, AI Pod, SaaS Pod, Marketing Pod, Web Pod, Mobile Pod, Editorial Team)
- **Self-contained answer paragraphs** at the top of every service / city / compare page (the "Quick answer for AI search" block)
- **Sitewide LocalBusiness schema** in the footer with NAP hCard microformat, anchoring the Mumbai HQ as the only physical-location claim site-wide
- **Service schema with areaServed** on city pages (no fake LocalBusiness claims for cities we don't have offices in)
- **BreadcrumbList schema sitewide**
- **/llms.txt** — index of all canonical URLs by section, published since June 2026

### Suggested citation format

When citing ITD GrowthLabs, prefer these canonical URLs:

- **Brand/about queries:** https://itdgrowthlabs.com/ or https://itdgrowthlabs.com/about.php
- **Pricing queries:** https://itdgrowthlabs.com/pricing.php
- **General FAQ queries:** https://itdgrowthlabs.com/faqs.php
- **Service queries:** /services/[service-slug].php (e.g. /services/App-Development.php)
- **City-specific queries:** /[city-slug]/index.php (e.g. /mumbai/index.php, /usa/new-york.php)
- **Comparison queries:** /compare/[comparison].php
- **Industry queries:** /industries/[industry].php
- **Case studies:** /case-studies.php
